rounds.title: Dark elevation edge
rounds.note: Q95: elevated panels, overlay panes and cards do not separate from the dark base surface. No variant changes a background colour: a) a 1 px light ring from surface tokens, b) stronger shadows in the dark scheme only, c) a top-edge highlight. Today in the dark scheme: a 1 px --et-surface-border ring (64) at 1.76:1 against the base (23) and 1.46:1 against the fill (38), 1.50:1 where a pane sits on a panel; the fill itself is 1.18:1 against the base. Every variant leaves the light scheme pixel-identical.

a.note: Pick. Ring 89 = color-mix(--et-surface-color-solid 24 %, --et-surface-background-solid), dark only: 2.61:1 against the base (today 1.76), 2.16:1 against the fill (1.46), 2.22:1 where the pane sits on a panel (1.50). The only edge that still holds where a pane meets a panel of its own colour, where no shadow can show. 3:1 against the base needs about 29 %. Needs a generated --et-surface-ring per surface theme (light: the border value).

b.note: Dark-only shadows with a 1 px black spread at 50 % and 60-70 % blurs. The 64 border stays: 1.92:1 against the darkened base above (today 1.76), 1.99 below, fill against the shadow 1.30-1.34 (1.23), pane on panel 1.86 (1.50). On a near-black base a shadow can only darken 23 to about 5, so it reads as a dark halo more than lift. Needs generated --et-elevation-shadow-* and a dark default for --et-anchored-panel-shadow.

c.note: Dark-only inset top highlight 76 = 18 % --et-surface-color-solid: 1.76:1 against the fill, 1.21:1 against the border above it. The outer edge stays as today (1.76 / 1.46), pane on panel 1.50; only the top edge lights up, sides and bottom do not. Needs a generated --et-surface-highlight per surface theme.
